evidence_quote: This Commission Recommendation encourages Member States to develop a comprehensive strategy for the adoption of Post-Quantum Cryptography... The strategy should define clear goals, milestones, and timelines

source_name: Recommendation on Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for PQC Transition
requirement: Cooperate with ENISA and cybersecurity experts to evaluate and select PQC algorithms for adoption as EU standards to ensure harmonized implementation.
evidence_quote: This Commission Recommendation encourages Member States to work at EU-level closely with... ENISA, on the evaluation and selection of the appropriate Post-Quantum Cryptography algorithms and their adoption as EU standards

source_name: Recommendation on Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for PQC Transition
requirement: Define a coordinated implementation roadmap with a clear timeline for different phases and milestones, including the use of hybrid schemes for transition.
evidence_quote: The Post-Quantum Cryptography Coordinated Implementation Roadmap should provide the list of actions... with a clear timeline for different phases and milestones... via hybrid schemes that may combine Post-Quantum Cryptography with existing cryptographic approaches

source_name: Recommendation on Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for PQC Transition
requirement: Ensure the PQC Coordinated Implementation Roadmap is available within two years of the recommendation's publication to guide national transition plans.
evidence_quote: The Post-Quantum Cryptography Coordinated Implementation Roadmap should be available after a period of two years following the publication of this Recommendation

source_name: Recommendation on Coordinated Implementation Roadmap for PQC Transition
